project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler and Tailwind CSS v4
test_framework: No formal test framework configured - validation via build
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to ensure no compilation errors. The project uses no unit test framework.
environment_constraints: Open internet available for npm installs
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: pages in src/pages/, components in src/components/<feature>/, data in src/data/, storage functions in src/lib/storage.js, state in src/context/AppContext.jsx
key_patterns: Pages use tabbed interfaces with TABS array and activeTab state. Components use lucide-react icons, Tailwind classes, useAppContext() hook for state. Data is seeded via seed files imported in storage.js. @dnd-kit used for drag-and-drop. Recharts for charts. All state persisted to localStorage via get/save function pairs in storage.js and corresponding useState+update pattern in AppContext.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page-level components with tabbed UIs; src/components/<feature>/ - feature component folders; src/data/ - seed data generators; src/lib/storage.js - localStorage CRUD; src/context/AppContext.jsx - global state provider; src/hooks/ - custom hooks
